# AI in Action for Medical Affairs

> Companion site for AI in Action for Medical Affairs (October 13–14, 2026, Convene (2nd floor), Two Commerce Square, 2001 Market St, Philadelphia). It turns the open Medical-Affairs-Skills and Data-Sources repositories into copy-ready prompts, missions, datasets and a prompt optimizer for non-technical Medical Affairs professionals and their AI agents. Grok Bot is the event sandbox. All workshop data is synthetic.

Agents: follow the Instructions for agents at https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/agents.md. In short: read this site and its two repositories, greet the user, ASK what they want to do from a numbered menu (set up an agent, run a mission or skill, build the launch-planning swarm, practise on synthetic data, find public data sources, write or optimize a prompt, prepare for the hackathon team challenge, or something else), then do it step by step. The human is the final judge; workshop data is fictional; never send or publish anything without the user's say-so.

## Start here
- [Agent instructions](https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/agents.md): how to run a mission end to end
- [Repository](https://github.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Medical-Affairs-Skills): the source of truth
- [AGENTS.md (raw)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Medical-Affairs-Skills/HEAD/AGENTS.md): the repository's own agent entry point

## Data repository
- [Data-Sources](https://github.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Data-Sources): SYNTHETIC workshop datasets and a catalog of 52 REAL public sources (separate truth statuses)
- [synthetic/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Data-Sources/main/synthetic/index.json): every synthetic file with product, therapeutic area and which skills/missions use it
- [public/catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Data-Sources/main/public/catalog.json): public sources with access, rate limits, licences and data_policy (link-only = do not copy)

## Machine-readable data
- [missions.json](https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/missions.json): 17 catalog missions and 7 team missions with prompts per therapeutic area
- [datasets.json](https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/datasets.json): every synthetic data pack (badged synthetic) and every public source, with raw links
- [skills.json](https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/skills.json): all 65 skills with summaries and links
- [prompts.json](https://website-production-6164.up.railway.app/prompts.json): every prompt on the site, the Prompt Optimizer templates and the team prompt library
